title: Troubleshooting
content:
# Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Where to look first |
| --- | --- |
| Server will not power on | iDRAC dashboard; `racadm getsel`; power supply LEDs |
| Temperature warnings | `racadm getsensorinfo`; check the air filter and cabinet fans |
| Drive failed | `racadm storage get pdisks`; see [[Storage layout]] |
| iDRAC unreachable | Management switch port; from the host OS run `racadm racreset` |
| OS unresponsive | iDRAC virtual console; `racadm serveraction hardreset` as a last resort |

## Logs

```
racadm getsel
racadm lclog view
```

## Collecting data for Dell support

Collect a technical support report and export it to the file share:

```
racadm techsupreport collect
racadm techsupreport export -l //10.60.0.30/tsr -u <SHARE-USER> -p <SHARE-PASSWORD>
```

Then open a case as described in [[Contacts and support]].
